name: labeldepth-p1-s2
description: DRAFT LABEL DEPTH vs PLAY DEPTH at ply 1 (coordinator 11-13 05:19; the analyst out of credits). levers-p2's final (depth-2 labels over ply-2 play) lost the labels lead by v400 (71/61 at v150, 63/45 at v300, -4/5 at v400 at ply 2), while labels-p1 (depth-2 labels over ply-1 play, two seeds) kept 48.5 at ply 1 and 74.5 at ply 2 at v500/v408. Hypothesis: a label no deeper than the play is a variance cut biased to the model's own search, a head start that result labels catch; a label deeper than the play carries information the games lack and keeps its lead. One ply-1 field, three lines on the same games: F-P result labels; F-P --label-depth 1 (= the play depth); F-P --label-depth 2 (= play + 1, labels-p1's line). Seeds 81/82, two runs. Reads vs the r/e/g/h @300 panel at plies 1-2 and the ply-3 strangers, at v150, v300, final (version windows at the final). PREDICTION: d2 - result 30-80 at ply 2 at the final (labels-p1: 74.5); d1 - result within 20 at the final after a lead at v150. RULE: d1 within 20 and d2 30+ (pooled over seeds) supports 'label deeper than play' (next: depth-3 labels over ply-2 play in the standard); d1 30+ too means labels pay at equal depth and levers-p2's v400 was field- or seed-specific. Cost ~1.1 CPU-h a run (labels-p1: ~7 CPU-s a cycle).
